caption: The drawing depicts a harp with a wooden appearance, featuring shades of brown and tan throughout its structure. The harp has an intricately carved column on the left, adorned with spiral and geometric decorative elements at the top. The neck of the harp curves smoothly to the right and is embellished with a series of small circular decorations along its length. The soundboard is triangular, extending downward from the neck to the base, and displays multiple rectangular panels each patterned with a set of small, dark holes arranged in geometric formations. The harp strings, drawn as thin, black or gray lines, extend vertically from the neck to various points along the soundboard. The base of the harp is rounded with softly contoured edges. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background, and there is handwritten text at the bottom and lower right corner, reading "Plate 2" and "Guill. Thomas Santa Fe," respectively.
title: Stringed Harp
